top_signals.title: S&P 500 Steadies After Three-Day Skid as Oil Prices Halt Advance
top_signals.summary: US stocks flipped between small gains and losses on Wednesday after a three-day skid, as oil prices halted a sharp advance, easing inflation concerns as traders weigh the Federal Reserve’s potential path for interest-rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: China Won’t Have Claims to Venezuelan Oil Revenue, Wright Says
top_signals.summary: With private companies on the cusp of signing a series of deals that will put Venezuela on pace to rapidly expand its crude output, US Energy Secretary Chris Wright said that China won’t have any debt claims to the revenue from new production.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Chevron to expand in Venezuela operations, doubling production through $7 billion investment
top_signals.summary: Chevron's move comes amid a U.S. push to increase oil production in Venezuela.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Uber to Cut 3,300 Jobs in Management Overhaul
top_signals.summary: Uber Technologies is cutting about 3,300 roles, or 10% of its staff globally, in a restructuring aimed at reducing management layers and reallocating spending into its ride-sharing, delivery and robotaxi businesses. Carmen Reinicke has more on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
